module_store.description: How libsemanage interacts with the SELinux policy manager (source, direct, path_to_socket, or host:port).

policy_version.description: The policy version to set when generating the final linked and expanded policy.

expand_check.description: Whether to check neverallow rules when executing semanage commands (0 or 1).

usepasswd.description: Whether to scan all password records for home directories and setup labeling correctly.

ignoredirs.description: Semicolon-separated list of directories to ignore.
